h.t: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
h.en: Actions are only by intentions, and every person shall have only what he intended.
Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you.

h.t: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
h.en: Your smile in the face of your brother is charity.
The best of you are those who learn the Qur’an and teach it.

h.t: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
h.en: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.

h.t: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
h.en: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.

h.t: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
h.en: Part of the excellence of a person’s Islam is leaving what does not concern him.

h.t: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
h.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

h.t: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
h.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

h.t: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
h.en: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out; and treat people with good character.

h.t: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
h.en: Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.

k.t: مَنْ جَدَّ وَجَدَ، وَمَنْ زَرَعَ حَصَدَ
k.en: Whoever strives, finds; whoever sows, reaps.
Every situation has its fitting words.
The best speech is brief and to the point.
Patience is the key to relief.

k.t: رُبَّ أَخٍ لَكَ لَمْ تَلِدْهُ أُمُّكَ
k.en: Many a brother of yours was not born of your mother.

k.t: الْعِلْمُ فِي الصِّغَرِ كَالنَّقْشِ عَلَى الْحَجَرِ
k.en: Learning in youth is like engraving on stone.

k.t: الْوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ، إِنْ لَمْ تَقْطَعْهُ قَطَعَكَ
k.en: Time is like a sword: if you do not cut it, it cuts you.
A person’s safety lies in guarding the tongue.

k.t: الْجَارَ قَبْلَ الدَّارِ، وَالرَّفِيقَ قَبْلَ الطَّرِيقِ
k.en: (Choose) the neighbour before the house, and the companion before the journey.

k.t: عِنْدَ الِامْتِحَانِ يُكْرَمُ الْمَرْءُ أَوْ يُهَانُ
k.en: At the time of trial a person is honoured or disgraced.
Whoever seeks the heights stays awake at night.

k.s: يُروى عن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
k.en: The worth of every person is what he does well.

k.s: يُروى عن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
k.en: People are enemies of what they do not know.

k.s: يُروى عن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه
k.en: When the mind is complete, speech becomes less.

k.s: أثر عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
k.en: Learn Arabic, for it is part of your religion.

k.t: كُنْ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا أَوْ مُسْتَمِعًا أَوْ مُحِبًّا، وَلَا تَكُنِ الْخَامِسَ فَتَهْلِكَ
k.en: Be a scholar, a learner, a listener or one who loves them — and do not be the fifth, lest you perish.

k.t: فَإِنَّ نَفْسَ اللُّغَةِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ مِنَ الدِّينِ، وَمَعْرِفَتَهَا فَرْضٌ وَاجِبٌ
k.s: شيخ الإسلام ابن تيمية، اقتضاء الصراط المستقيم
k.en: The Arabic language itself is part of the religion, and knowing it is an obligation.

v: عَلَى قَدْرِ أَهْلِ الْعَزْمِ تَأْتِي الْعَزَائِمُ
p.en: Resolve comes in the measure of resolute people, and noble deeds in the measure of the noble.

v: أَعَزُّ مَكَانٍ فِي الدُّنَى سَرْجُ سَابِحٍ
p.en: The dearest place in the world is the saddle of a swift horse, and the best companion at all times is a book.

v: مَا كُلُّ مَا يَتَمَنَّى الْمَرْءُ يُدْرِكُهُ
تَجْرِي الرِّيَاحُ بِمَا لَا تَشْتَهِي السُّفُنُ
p.en: Not all that a person wishes does he attain; the winds blow in ways the ships do not desire.
When souls are great, bodies grow weary in pursuing their aims.
If you honour the noble, you win him; if you honour the base, he rebels.
Nations last only as long as their morals; if their morals go, they go.
Stand for the teacher and give him full honour; the teacher is almost a messenger.

v: أَنَا الْبَحْرُ فِي أَحْشَائِهِ الدُّرُّ كَامِنٌ
p.en: (Arabic speaks:) I am the sea, pearls lie hidden in its depths — have they asked the diver about my shells?
I complained to Wakī‘ of my poor memory; he guided me to leave sins, and told me that knowledge is light, and Allah’s light is not given to a sinner.
Let the days do as they will, and be content when the decree is passed.

v: لِسَانَكَ لَا تَذْكُرْ بِهِ عَوْرَةَ امْرِئٍ
p.en: Do not mention anyone’s faults with your tongue: you are all faults, and people have eyes.

v: وَمَهْمَا تَكُنْ عِنْدَ امْرِئٍ مِنْ خَلِيقَةٍ
وَإِنْ خَالَهَا تَخْفَى عَلَى النَّاسِ تُعْلَمِ
p.en: Whatever trait a person has, though he thinks it hidden from people, it becomes known.
Youth, free time and wealth are a great corruption for a person.
Seek knowledge and do not be lazy — how far good is from the lazy!
